test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_substring_nullable (s Nullable(String)) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE t_substring_lc_nullable (s LowCardinality(Nullable(String))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_substring_nullable SELECT if(number % 100 = 0, NULL, concat('key', toString(number), '=valuevaluevaluevaluevalue')) FROM numbers(10000000)
INSERT INTO t_substring_lc_nullable SELECT concat('key', toString(number % 5000), '=valuevaluevaluevaluevalue') FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT substring(s, toUInt64(3)) FROM t_substring_nullable FORMAT Null
SELECT substring(s, toInt64(3)) FROM t_substring_nullable FORMAT Null
SELECT left(s, toUInt64(5)) FROM t_substring_nullable FORMAT Null
SELECT left(s, toUInt64(5)) FROM t_substring_lc_nullable FORMAT Null
SELECT left(s, toInt64(5)) FROM t_substring_lc_nullable FORMAT Null
